name: Kunbaja (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kunbaja (a blue shield with a red pale, a sabre and a rose, with a helm and red, yellow and blue mantling) above the name KUNBAJA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kunbaja arms with helm and mantling
